artworks.title: Six Heads, a Turk in Front
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of four individuals depicted from the chest up. The figures are in a tight group facing left. Their facial features are distinct with strong noses and chins, and varying expressions. The hair is styled intricately, with turbans on the first three figures. The clothing is detailed with patterns and textures. The background is filled with cross-hatched lines.

artworks.title: The Ford (Le passage du gué)
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a pastoral scene from an elevated vantage point. The horizon is high, with trees dominating the landscape. The artwork features intricate brushstrokes typical of etching, giving texture to the trees and figures. The black and white color palette highlights light and shadow. Closest to us, goats are seen with a man and woman nearby. In the background, more figures are engaged in activities. The scene is completed by a dense forest in the background.

artworks.title: Jan Snellinx
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body illustration of a man facing slightly to the left, with a bald head and neatly trimmed facial hair. He is in an artistic pose with his head turned to the left. He wears a garment with a high, open collar and visible button details at the front. His right hand is placed on his chest. The background has finely etched lines, resembling a detailed etching. The bottom of the image states "Joannes Snellinx Pictor."

artworks.title: Bust of a Saint
artworks.description: The image is a closely cropped, highly detailed drawing that shows the upper torso and head of an elderly man who is slightly hunched forward. He is depicted in profile, gazing upwards to his right. His facial features are pronounced, with a prominent, curly white beard and bushy eyebrows, and his hair is thinning and curly. The man wears a garment that appears to be draped around his shoulders, with a visible button or decorative element. His right hand is visible, holding onto a rosary or set of prayer beads with large knuckles and slightly bent fingers. The background of the image is filled with fine, directional lines.

artworks.title: Old Man Meditating
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust-length portrait of an older man. The man is facing forward, with his head turned slightly to his left. He has a long, full beard with deep-set eyes, pronounced wrinkles, wavy hair, and a cap or cloth partially covering his head. There is a curl of hair visible behind his head. He wears a large, ruffled collar, a coat with a patterned design on the chest, and an ornamental piece around his neck that resembles a large chain or medallion. The background consists of intricate, cross-hatched lines for texture and depth, without a specific scene or setting.

artworks.title: Allegory of Virtue
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene with multiple figures. The central female figure is being supported by others, while an angelic figure flies above holding or interacting with her. There are two male figures, one blindfolded and helping the central figure, and another draped in cloth gesturing theatrically. A female figure lies at the bottom, possibly reaching out. The scene is set amidst rocky elements, suggesting a dynamic background. The drawing is in a detailed Renaissance style with careful shading and line work.

artworks.title: Sibyl Reading
artworks.artist: Italian 16th Century, after Ugo da Carpi, after Raphael
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from two blocks in black and brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from head to toe. One person is seated, facing left, holding an open book. They have refined facial features, styled hair, and wear a flowing dress with puffed sleeves. The other individual is a child standing and leaning slightly towards the seated person. The child has curly hair and a cherubic face, wearing loose-fitting attire with a skirt-like bottom and holding a torch. The background is simply drawn, indicating an indoor setting with vertical lines on the walls and a partially visible piece of furniture, potentially a chair or bench.

artworks.title: A Headpiece in the Form of a Fan
artworks.description: The image shows an intricate decorative design with several medallion-like illustrations, acanthus leaves, a sculpted portrait of a woman's face, shell-like ornamentation, foliage designs, a pastoral landscape, a body of water, framing elements, classical figures, and ornate borders. The composition is highly detailed with rich textures, blending nature, human portraiture, and ornamental scrollwork in a Baroque style.

artworks.title: Young Woman and Death
artworks.description: The image features a woman standing next to a skeletal figure. The woman has a detailed expression on her face and is wearing a historical-style headpiece and ornate clothing. She holds a bouquet of flowers in her right hand and an hourglass in her left hand. The skeleton is reaching out towards her waist. In the background, there is textured terrain and an inscription to the side.

artworks.title: Soo D'oude Songen Soo Pepen De Jongen (As the old sing, so the young twitter)
artworks.artist: Schelte Adams Bolswert after Jacob Jordaens
artworks.description: This image depicts a group of people sitting closely together at a table. The central figure is a woman holding a child on her lap. The woman has curly hair and is wearing a patterned hat and pearl jewelry. The child she holds is playing a flute. To the left, an elderly woman sits in a high-backed wicker chair, reading a document. Behind and partially to the left, a dog is looking attentively towards the group. On the far right side, a bearded man with glasses reads aloud from a book held open in front of him, gesturing with one hand. Next to him, a second man plays a wind instrument, dressed in a loose shirt with a vest and a cloth cap. At the table, a boy is seated, eating grapes while looking towards the woman and child. The table is covered with a cloth and spread with various objects. The background is a detailed wall featuring elaborate designs and text framed with decorative elements.

artworks.title: The Family in the Room
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 18.4 x 21.4 cm (7 1/4 x 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated on an armchair holding a baby in her lap, positioned to the right of the image. She is sitting in front of a large arched window with a detailed grid design. The woman's facial features are not distinctly visible but she has a headscarf covering her head. She is wearing a long-sleeved dress with a checked pattern. Next to her is a standing figure, likely a man, who appears to be looking down at her and the baby, with one hand resting on the window ledge. The room's background is dimly lit, with heavy curtains and an elaborate wooden chair partly visible. A chandelier or hanging lamp, along with various textured and shadowy objects, furnish the space.

artworks.title: Comment! encore une caricature sur nous...
artworks.description: The image displays two women in a room. The woman on the left is standing with a hunched posture, holding her skirt with tension in her facial expression. She has dark hair and wears a long, light dress. The woman on the right is seated, wearing a head covering and a dark dress. She holds a book with the title "Bas bleus" visible. The background shows architectural details and framed artwork on the walls.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.description: The image shows two adults and one child, displaying their upper bodies. The adult on the left is sitting with a slightly forward-leaning posture, face turned towards the child, wearing a turban-style headdress. The adult on the right is also sitting, slightly hunched over, with their head inclined downwards toward the child, wearing a cloth wrapped around their head and clothing that drapes in folds around their body. The child is nestled between them, held in the arms of the adult on the right, wearing a covering that wraps around the body. The setting appears to be indoors with a textured, cross-hatched background. Additionally, a garment hangs in the background.

artworks.title: The Last Judgment
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. Robert M. Light
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene featuring a hierarchical portrayal of figures surrounded by elaborate details. The central motif shows a distinguished figure sitting on a throne, flanked by other figures, both standing and seated. Below the central figure, an armored figure holds scales. The drawing is encased in a detailed border with floral and architectural motifs. At the bottom of the composition, a dichotomy is presented—people are shown in different settings, one side crowded and the other more barren or fiery. The intricate detailing throughout, including the pattern work and the stylized human figures, suggests a highly symbolic composition typical of religious or allegorical art.

artworks.title: Giovanni Battista Piranesi
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. Robert M. Light
artworks.description: The image features an engraving of a sculptural portrait of a man in profile, displaying only the head and shoulders. The man has short, curly hair and distinct facial features in a classical Roman style. He is enclosed in a circular frame resembling a coin or medallion, set against a stone-like background. Latin inscriptions above and below provide biographical details like his name, "IO BAPT PIRANENSIS," and titles, "VENETUS ARCHITECTUS." The background appears like a weathered stone wall. Additional sculptural elements, such as a column and shield, are present on the right side. Below the portrait, decorative architectural elements like scrolls, floral motifs, and miniature buildings enrich the classical theme, along with faint remnants of a map or architectural plan.

artworks.title: The Rt. Reverend William Lawrence
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Rt. Rev. Frederic C. Lawrence

artworks.title: Design for a Wall Decoration [recto]
artworks.medium: brush with brown and black ink and color washes, heightened with white, over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical architectural scene featuring statues and a dog. The image depicts an ornate structure with detailed arches and pilasters. There is a statue of a nude figure standing on a pedestal. In the foreground, there is a dog, and above the arches there are further decorative elements and small statues. The composition is dominated by a sense of grandeur and resembles a stage set or a theatrical backdrop, with open spaces and symmetrical design, invoking a sense of depth and elegance. The use of lines and shading in the drawing gives a strong sense of three-dimensionality to the architecture depicted.

artworks.title: Sheet of Studies with the Drunken Pan and Nymphs [verso]
artworks.medium: black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a series of abstract sketches. The drawing consists of various rough, freehand sketches scattered on a worn piece of paper. There are faint outlines of figures and geometric shapes in red. The composition is chaotic with scribbles and curved lines, and is accompanied by some indistinct text. The paper is aged.

artworks.title: Michael d'Aicing
artworks.creditLine: Dr. and Mrs. Ronald R. Lubritz Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a profile portrait of a man with curly hair and a prominent beard. He is wearing formal attire with a high ruffled collar. The background features horizontal lines and below the portrait, there is a decorative element with calligraphic text and a compass-like design.

artworks.title: The Poor Fisherman (Le Pauvre pêcheur)
artworks.medium: lithograph in purple on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a small boat near the shore with a man doing work on it. Nearby, two children are seen on the sloped landscape. The horizon is faintly visible in the background. The drawing features light pencil strokes defining the man and children, with a gentle and sketchy style conveying texture and depth. The color palette is muted, primarily consisting of natural tones. The overall scene evokes a tranquil moment.

artworks.title: The Tuileries Garden (Le jardin des Tuileries)
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Rosenwald Collection) and Friends of Esther Stuttman
artworks.description: The image shows a park scene with a high horizon, sparse line of trees in the distance, a cluster of trees and bushes in the center-left, birds, pathways, and figures in the background. The color palette is mainly soft yellows, off-whites, and pale hints of blue and green.

artworks.title: Circe
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in burnt orange and black
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures and creatures rendered in a monochrome, reddish-brown color scheme. In the center, there is a figure draped in flowing fabric in a dynamic pose. Surrounding this figure are other beings and creatures captured in a swirling motion. The background features abstract architectural structures. The style of the composition suggests influence from Baroque or Rococo traditions.

artworks.title: Jupiter Nourished by the Goat Amalthea
artworks.description: The image features four individuals in full body. On the left, a woman sits, looking towards the viewer, draped in cloth and touching a mammal-like creature in the center. The central figure has features of a human and a goat, playing a horn instrument. Beside it, a child lies reaching up. On the right, an adult holds a goat. The background shows detailed trees and foliage.

artworks.title: The Pilgrims
artworks.description: This is a drawing portraying a group scene with individuals holding placards. The artwork shows an assembly of figures in a crowded formation, each carrying poles with papers or signs attached. The figures are depicted with different textures in their clothing. The background is filled with horizontal lines, emphasizing the density of the crowd. The use of black lines against a lighter background highlights the intricacies of the scene.
